identification: Two loose vintage Kenner Star Wars figures, c.1977-78 first-wave style: Darth Vader with cloth-style vinyl cape (no saber) and Ben (Obi-Wan) Kenobi with red/brown vinyl cloak (no saber). Photo shows Kenobi with a grey-haired head and Vader cape with worn edges. Cape type, COO marks (Hong Kong/Taiwan/Lili Ledy/Kenner) and whether Kenobi has a fine-grey vs thick hair head are not verifiable from photo. Both are missing weapons, which lowers value.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) with: star wars kenner; darth vader figure; kenobi; star wars vintage. No SOLD resale comps for loose vintage Vader or Kenobi found; only paid-locally hits and unrelated Leski/Noble items (life-size model, Niue coins, busts).
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold/Terapeak: 'Kenner Star Wars Darth Vader loose vintage 1977 no weapon', 'Kenner Star Wars Ben Kenobi loose vintage no weapon', 'vintage Star Wars figures lot Vader Obi-Wan' (last 90 days, sold, AUD). Also eBay.com sold (convert USD) and WorthPoint for loose 12-back Vader/Ben Kenobi. Check LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable for loose vintage Kenner figure lots. Note typical loose Vader/Ben without weapons are low-value; value rises only with the original saber/COO marks intact.
viewing_check: Look at the feet/back of the legs and the back of the head for COO stamps (Hong Kong, Taiwan, Lili Ledy, Mexico, Kenner), confirm both are genuine Kenner (not reproductions), check Kenobi cloak for tears and cape edge condition on Vader, check for paint wear on Vader chest, limb tightness and any discolouration or chewing. Note the Vader cape: is it the original vinyl. Check for any weapons in the lot.
rate_note: All prices already AUD; no conversion.
